description: This file defines a custom validator class 'FieldMatchValidator' used for validating that two fields in a Java object are equal, typically used in form validation scenarios.

classes.name: FieldMatchValidator
classes.description: A validator class that checks if two specified fields in an object are equal, implementing the ConstraintValidator interface.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the validator with the field names to compare, as specified in the annotation.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates whether the two specified fields in the input object are equal, handling nulls and catching exceptions.
